title.rendered: Stay on Track with Preventive Maintenance Inspections

content.rendered:
VAN DYK’s Preventive Maintenance Inspection (PMI) plan is a yearly plan that services our customers and their Bollegraaf, Lubo, and TOMRA machinery. The plan includes two equipment checkups per year to diagnose any unforeseen problems that may be arising. It is designed to detect and prevent potential problems before they occur to keep your downtime to a minimum. Our expert service technicians will visit your site and conduct a thorough inspection on all parts of the designated equipment. If any issues are detected, they will schedule a repair or make the repair on the spot.

Why Sign Up for a PMI Plan?

  • With regular visits and the proper adjustments, your machine will remain reliable and at the peak of productivity.
  • Diagnosing and replacing worn parts will prevent malfunctions and reduce your downtime.
  • The program is proven to lower overall maintenance costs and prolong the lifetime of your machine.
  • Customers who schedule preventive maintenance have fewer emergency repairs, lower overall service costs, and increased production time.

*Remember: preventive maintenance packages are not a substitute for routine maintenance work. The customer should still perform regular maintenance on their equipment.

PRICING

All PMI plans are priced at a custom rate. Contact our service department at 203-967-1100 or service@vdrs.com.

Included in the price of all plans:

  • Two visits per year, eight hours allotted for each visit
  • Cost of flight or mileage, plus travel time
  • Detailed report of each visit (records are also kept on file at VAN DYK headquarters)
  • Any small repairs that can be made within the allotted time
  • Expenses

Excluded from the price of all packages:

  • Spare parts

Additional benefits:

  • Any overtime in excess of eight hours will be billed at regular rate (not overtime rate).

Notes:

  • Preventive maintenance visits must be taken within one year of entering the plan or they will expire.
  • Packages will be automatically renewed after one year unless canceled by the customer.

For more information or a custom quote, contact VAN DYK Service, 203-967-1100 / service@vdrs.com.
